title: 富兰克林邓普顿David Mann：主动ETF在美净流入占37%，亚洲监管会跟进吗？
speaker: David Mann

segments.en: David, how would you assess the regulatory environment in mainland China now?
segments.zh: David，你如何评估当前内地的监管环境？

segments.en: Because they have been sort of loosening the rules when it comes to ETF trading or the composition or the launches of ETFs. How does that impact your business?
segments.zh: 因为他们在ETF交易、构成或发行方面有所放宽。这对你们的业务有何影响？

segments.en: So one of the trends that we're sort of monitoring globally and I think it will be applicable to Asia is active ETFs.
segments.zh: 我们全球监测的趋势之一，我认为也适用于亚洲，就是主动ETF。

segments.en: And you know, if I kind of go back in time, there was always this association between ETF meeting indexing.
segments.zh: 回顾过去，人们总是把ETF与指数化联系在一起。

segments.en: And so it's really been encouraging to watch the investor shift to start appreciating that they didn't get active expertise within the ETF vehicle.
segments.zh: 令人鼓舞的是，投资者开始意识到可以在ETF载体中获得主动管理专长。

segments.en: So somewhat amazingly, there's now more than 1,000 active ETFs in the US compared to index strategies, which is a recent trend.
segments.zh: 令人惊讶的是，美国现在有超过1000只主动ETF，与指数策略相比，这是近期趋势。

segments.en: Active ETFs in the US are representing 37% of the net inflows.
And that's a trend that I think is going to start showing up in other regions, including UCIS, which we were starting to see in terms of Asia.
segments.zh: 我认为这一趋势将开始出现在其他地区，包括UCIS，我们在亚洲也开始看到。

segments.en: So when I think about the regulatory environment, it was a huge boom for active management when the US regulators kind of put the stamp of approval.
segments.zh: 所以谈到监管环境，当美国监管机构予以认可时，主动管理迎来了巨大发展。

segments.en: That everything that an index fund can do, an active strategy can do as well within the ETF vehicle.
segments.zh: 指数产品能做的，主动策略在ETF载体中也能做到。

segments.en: That's the kind of regulatory vision I could start seeing in Hong Kong and Asia as the active strategies become more acceptable.
segments.zh: 随着主动策略越来越被接受，这种监管愿景可能开始在香港和亚洲出现。
